people.paul.role: Apostle who explains his plans and defends his work
people.paul.relations: He writes with Timothy. Titus brings him news and finishes the gift.
people.paul.meaning: Paul explains why he changed his travel plans. He wrote earlier with many tears to spare them sorrow. He asks them to forgive and comfort the one who caused sorrow. He sends Titus and two brothers to finish the gift. He warns that he is coming a third time.
people.jesus.role: Crucified and risen Lord whose power works in weakness
people.jesus.relations: Paul calls him the Son of God, preached by Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy. Paul says he became poor for the readers’ sake.
people.jesus.meaning: Paul says that in Jesus is the “Yes” to all God’s promises. Paul says Jesus became poor so the readers might become rich. Paul asked that the thorn leave him. The Lord answered that his grace is enough and his power works in weakness.
people.timothy.role: Brother named with Paul in the greeting
people.timothy.relations: The letter names him beside Paul. Paul says Timothy and Silvanus preached Jesus Christ with him.
people.timothy.meaning: Paul names Timothy as our brother in the first line. In 1:19 Paul says Timothy preached the Son of God with him. They preached among the Corinthians. Paul uses this to show that their word was not “Yes and no.”
people.silas.role: Preacher of Jesus Christ with Paul and Timothy
people.silas.relations: Paul names him between himself and Timothy in 1:19.
people.silas.meaning: Paul names Silvanus once, in 1:19. He says Silvanus, Timothy, and Paul preached Jesus Christ among the Corinthians. Paul uses this to answer the charge that his plans change.
people.moses.role: Leader whose face shone with fading glory
people.moses.relations: Paul sets the engraved stones beside hearts of flesh. He says the veil remains when Moses is read.
people.moses.meaning: Paul says Israel could not look at Moses’ face for its glory. Moses put a veil on his face. Paul says the new service has much more glory. He says the veil is taken away when someone turns to the Lord.
people.titus.role: Paul’s partner who brings news and finishes the gift
people.titus.relations: Paul calls him my brother, my partner, and fellow worker. Two other brothers go with him.
people.titus.meaning: At Troas Paul has no relief because he does not find Titus. In Macedonia Titus arrives with good news from Corinth. Paul sends him back to finish the gift. In chapter 12 Paul asks whether Titus took advantage of them.
places.damascus.summary: Paul tells of Damascus in chapter 11. The governor under King Aretas guarded the city to arrest him. Paul was let down in a basket through a window in the wall.
places.damascus.limits: The marker shows the city’s general location.
places.corinth.summary: Paul writes in chapter 1 to the assembly of God at Corinth. He explains why he did not come there.
places.corinth.limits: The marker shows the city’s general location.
sources.web.summary: All thirteen chapters are the main text for original close readings.
sources.web.limits: The letter’s claims and remembered events are its own account. The guide did not check manuscripts, dates, authorship, or possible earlier letters. It did not check who the unnamed offender was. It did not check what the thorn was.
sources.tiede-2cor.summary: Tiede reads Paul’s confidence as coming through Christ’s power in weakness.
sources.tiede-2cor.limits: This is Tiede’s own reading. The guide did not check his wider claims about ancient speaking customs, mystery religions, or visions. It did not review the Newbigin book he cites or related commentaries.
sources.cfm-nt-2023-38.summary: The lesson studies comfort, forgiveness, restored relationship with God, and repentance.
sources.cfm-nt-2023-38.limits: Church teaching is separate from original close reading. Coverage follows the lesson body, not its wider heading. The guide did not check the linked full talks, manuals, videos, or Restoration passages.
sources.cfm-nt-2023-39.summary: The lesson studies generous giving, simple discipleship, and grace in weakness.
sources.cfm-nt-2023-39.limits: Church teaching is separate from original close reading. Coverage follows the lesson body, not its wider heading. The guide did not check the linked full talks, manuals, videos, or Restoration passages.
